items.headline: U.S. Stocks Rebound, Snapping Four-Day Losing Streak Amid Easing Oil Prices and In-Line CPI
items.summary: U.S. equities ended sharply higher on Friday, September 11, 2026, breaking a four-session losing streak. The positive momentum was driven by a retreat in crude oil prices from elevated levels and the release of August's Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which largely met economists' expectations. This performance came despite the August inflation data strengthening the likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week.

items.headline: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Surges on AI Demand
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. ($HPE) surged 12.43% to $62.09, extending a post-earnings re-rating. The gain was driven by accelerating demand for AI servers, networking, and storage infrastructure, building on recently raised fiscal 2026 guidance.

items.headline: Dell Technologies Jumps on Outperform Rating
items.summary: Dell Technologies ($DELL) shares jumped 11.98% to $567.30 after RBC initiated coverage with an Outperform rating, citing robust free cash flow and a significant competitive advantage in AI infrastructure deployment.

items.headline: Skyworks Solutions Continues Upward Trend
items.summary: Skyworks Solutions ($SWKS) posted a gain of 9.8%, contributing to its appearance on the one-month winners list with a total return of +23.0%.

items.headline: Navan Sees Significant Decline
items.summary: Navan ($NAVN) experienced a sharp decline of 21.7% during the trading session.

items.headline: August CPI Report Fuels Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4% in August, bringing the 12-month increase to 3.4%, aligning with Dow Jones consensus forecasts. Core CPI, excluding volatile food and energy prices, increased 0.3% for the month, slightly above the 0.2% forecast, and the core annual rate stood at 2.4%. This data has significantly increased the market's expectation for a Federal Reserve rate hike at its upcoming policy meeting.

items.headline: Oil Prices Retreat, Easing Inflationary Pressure
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices fell 2.8% to settle at $104.61 a barrel on Friday, pulling back from earlier highs that had neared $110. This decline provided some relief from recent inflation concerns, as oil prices had surged in previous sessions due to the ongoing Middle East conflict.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Remain Elevated Amid Rate Hike Bets
items.summary: Treasury yields remained elevated, with the 10-year Treasury yield trading at an still-elevated 4.9% on Friday, after reaching a nearly three-year high on Thursday. Markets are now pricing in an 85.6% chance of a Fed rate hike at the upcoming Federal Reserve policy meeting, according to CME FedWatch.

items.headline: Technology and Communication Services Lead Market Rebound, Utilities and Health Care Lag
items.summary: Friday's rally saw a broad market advance, with nine of the 11 major S&P 500 sectors closing higher. Communication Services was the top-performing sector with a gain of 1.35%, followed by Information Technology (+1.50%) and Industrials (+1.10%), as investors rotated back into growth-oriented and cyclical areas. Conversely, the Utilities sector was the worst-performing, declining by 0.34% to 0.08%, with Health Care also lagging with a loss of 0.20% to 0.35%.

items.headline: Kroger Reports Solid Q2 2026 Results, Reaffirms Guidance
items.summary: The Kroger Co. ($KR) reported solid results for its second quarter ended August 15, 2026, with adjusted EPS growth of 5%. The company reaffirmed its full-year adjusted net earnings per diluted share guidance, despite lowering its full-year 2026 identical sales without fuel guidance. Identical sales without fuel increased 0.2%.

items.headline: CEA Industries Releases Q1 2027 Earnings
items.summary: CEA Industries ($BNC) announced its Q1 2027 earnings after market close on September 11, 2026, reporting an actual EPS of -$0.28 and revenue of $7.17 million.
